title: Income-tax Act — Section 22 (Income from house property)

content.overview: Section 22 charges the annual value of property consisting of any buildings or lands appurtenant thereto of which the assessee is the owner.
content.glance: Section 22 charges the annual value of property consisting of any buildings or lands appurtenant thereto of which the assessee is the owner.
content.study: The annual value of buildings or lands appurtenant thereto, of which the assessee is the owner, is chargeable under the head Income from house property, unless the property is occupied for the assessee's business or profession whose profits are chargeable to tax.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 22 charges the annual value of property consisting of any buildings or lands appurtenant thereto of which the assessee is the owner.
